sql: CREATE INDEX journal_entries_by_date ON journal_entries (date)

sql: CREATE INDEX ledger_lines_by_account ON ledger_lines (account_id)

name: ledger_lines_by_customer
sql: CREATE INDEX ledger_lines_by_customer ON ledger_lines (customer_id) WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL

name: ledger_lines_by_supplier
sql: CREATE INDEX ledger_lines_by_supplier ON ledger_lines (supplier_id) WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL

name: payment_allocations_by_entry
sql: CREATE INDEX payment_allocations_by_entry ON payment_allocations (entry_id)

name: sales_receipt_payments_by_receipt
sql: CREATE INDEX sales_receipt_payments_by_receipt ON sales_receipt_payments (receipt_id)

name: sales_receipts_by_date
sql: CREATE INDEX sales_receipts_by_date ON sales_receipts (date)

name: sales_receipts_by_shift
sql: CREATE INDEX sales_receipts_by_shift ON sales_receipts (shift_id)

name: sales_return_lines_by_receipt_line
sql: CREATE INDEX sales_return_lines_by_receipt_line ON sales_return_lines (receipt_line_id)

name: sales_returns_by_shift
sql: CREATE INDEX sales_returns_by_shift ON sales_returns (shift_id)

name: serial_movements_by_serial
sql: CREATE INDEX serial_movements_by_serial ON serial_movements (serial_id)

name: serial_movements_by_source
sql: CREATE INDEX serial_movements_by_source ON serial_movements (source, source_id)

name: serials_by_serial
sql: CREATE INDEX serials_by_serial ON serials (serial)

name: shifts_one_open_per_user
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shifts_one_open_per_user ON shifts (user_id) WHERE closed_at IS NULL

name: stock_movements_by_item
sql: CREATE INDEX stock_movements_by_item ON stock_movements (item_id, warehouse_id)

name: stock_movements_by_source
sql: CREATE INDEX stock_movements_by_source ON stock_movements (source, source_id)

name: accounts
sql:
CREATE TABLE accounts (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          name TEXT NOT NULL,
          type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'income', 'expense')),
          role TEXT UNIQUE,
          active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
        ) STRICT

name: audit_log
sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          at TEXT NOT NULL,
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          action TEXT NOT NULL,
          entity_id INTEGER,
          detail TEXT NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: business_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE business_settings (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
          name TEXT NOT NULL,
          address TEXT NOT NULL,
          tax_registration_number TEXT NOT NULL,
          vat_registered INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (vat_registered IN (0, 1)),
          fiscal_year_start_month INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (fiscal_year_start_month BETWEEN 1 AND 12)
        , lock_date TEXT, backup_folder TEXT, last_backup_at TEXT) STRICT

name: cash_movements
sql:
CREATE TABLE cash_movements (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          shift_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id),
          at TEXT NOT NULL,
          direction TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('in', 'out')),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
          account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
          reason TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id)
        ) STRICT

name: credit_note_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE credit_note_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          note_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_notes (id),
          invoice_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoice_lines (id),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          net INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL,
          cost INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: credit_notes
sql:
CREATE TABLE credit_notes (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id),
          reason TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          eta_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          eta_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        ) STRICT

name: customers
sql:
CREATE TABLE customers (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          name TEXT NOT NULL,
          phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          tax_registration_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
        , address TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', price_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'retail' CHECK (price_level IN ('retail', 'wholesale')), credit_limit INTEGER CHECK (credit_limit IS NULL OR credit_limit >= 0), withholding_category_id INTEGER REFERENCES withholding_categories (id), governate TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', region_city TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', building_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '') STRICT

name: debit_note_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE debit_note_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          note_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES debit_notes (id),
          purchase_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoice_lines (id),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          net INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: debit_notes
sql:
CREATE TABLE debit_notes (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          purchase_invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id),
          reason TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id)
        ) STRICT

name: eta_documents
sql:
CREATE TABLE eta_documents (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('invoice', 'credit_note')),
          document_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
          status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'failed', 'submitted', 'valid', 'invalid', 'cancelled')),
          uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          issued_at TEXT,
          updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          UNIQUE (kind, document_id)
        ) STRICT

name: eta_settings
sql:
CREATE TABLE eta_settings (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
          enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)),
          environment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'preprod' CHECK (environment IN ('preprod', 'production')),
          client_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          client_secret TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          activity_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          governate TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          region_city TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          street TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          building_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          certificate TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        , receipts_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (receipts_enabled IN (0, 1)), pos_serial TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pos_os_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pos_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pos_client_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pos_client_secret TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pos_preshared_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', pos_last_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '') STRICT

name: expenses
sql:
CREATE TABLE expenses (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (vat >= 0),
          -- Paid from a money account, or owed to a supplier.
          money_account_id INTEGER REFERENCES accounts (id),
          supplier_id INTEGER REFERENCES suppliers (id),
          memo TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          CHECK ((money_account_id IS NULL) <> (supplier_id IS NULL))
        ) STRICT

name: held_sales
sql:
CREATE TABLE held_sales (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          at TEXT NOT NULL,
          note TEXT NOT NULL,
          cart TEXT NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: import_shipment_costs
sql:
CREATE TABLE import_shipment_costs (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          shipment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES import_shipments (id),
          kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('customs_duty', 'freight', 'clearance', 'insurance', 'other')),
          supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (vat >= 0)
        ) STRICT

name: import_shipment_invoices
sql:
CREATE TABLE import_shipment_invoices (
          shipment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES import_shipments (id),
          purchase_invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id)
        ) STRICT

name: import_shipment_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE import_shipment_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          shipment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES import_shipments (id),
          purchase_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoice_lines (id),
          allocated INTEGER NOT NULL,
          to_stock INTEGER NOT NULL,
          to_cost_of_sales INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: import_shipments
sql:
CREATE TABLE import_shipments (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          reference TEXT NOT NULL,
          spread_by TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (spread_by IN ('value', 'quantity')),
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id)
        ) STRICT

name: item_units
sql:
CREATE TABLE item_units (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('base', 'pack')),
          name TEXT NOT NULL,
          size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size > 0),
          barcode TEXT UNIQUE,
          sale_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sale_price >= 0), wholesale_price INTEGER CHECK (wholesale_price >= 0),
          UNIQUE (item_id, kind),
          CHECK (kind = 'pack' OR size = 1000)
        ) STRICT

name: items
sql:
CREATE TABLE items (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          name_ar TEXT NOT NULL,
          name_en TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          code TEXT UNIQUE,
          tax_code_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tax_codes (id),
          egs_code TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
        , serialised INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (serialised IN (0, 1)), warranty_months INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (warranty_months >= 0), min_quantity INTEGER CHECK (min_quantity >= 0)) STRICT

name: journal_entries
sql:
CREATE TABLE journal_entries (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          memo TEXT NOT NULL,
          kind TEXT NOT NULL
        , voided_by INTEGER REFERENCES journal_entries (id)) STRICT

name: ledger_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
          debit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (debit >= 0),
          credit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (credit >= 0),
          memo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', supplier_id INTEGER REFERENCES suppliers (id), customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers (id), foreign_amount INTEGER CHECK (foreign_amount >= 0), cleared INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cleared IN (0, 1)),
          CHECK ((debit = 0) <> (credit = 0))
        ) STRICT

name: money_transfers
sql:
CREATE TABLE money_transfers (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          from_account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
          to_account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
          memo TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id)
        ) STRICT

name: payment_allocations
sql:
CREATE TABLE payment_allocations (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          payment_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES payments (id),
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0)
        , egp_amount INTEGER) STRICT

name: payments
sql:
CREATE TABLE payments (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('customer', 'supplier')),
          number INTEGER NOT NULL,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers (id),
          supplier_id INTEGER REFERENCES suppliers (id),
          account_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
          reference TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP', rate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000000 CHECK (rate > 0), withholding_category_id INTEGER REFERENCES withholding_categories (id), withholding_rate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, withholding_base INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (withholding_base >= 0), withholding_amount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (withholding_amount >= 0),
          UNIQUE (kind, number),
          CHECK ((kind = 'customer') = (customer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (kind = 'supplier') = (supplier_id IS NOT NULL))
        ) STRICT

name: purchase_invoice_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE purchase_invoice_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES purchase_invoices (id),
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unit IN ('base', 'pack')),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
          net INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat_rate INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: purchase_invoices
sql:
CREATE TABLE purchase_invoices (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          supplier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id),
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          reference TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id)
        , currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP', rate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000000 CHECK (rate > 0)) STRICT

name: quotation_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE quotation_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          quotation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES quotations (id),
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unit IN ('base', 'pack')),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
          discount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (discount >= 0)
        ) STRICT

name: quotations
sql:
CREATE TABLE quotations (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          valid_until TEXT NOT NULL,
          customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id),
          reference TEXT NOT NULL,
          notes TEXT NOT NULL,
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          invoice_id INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES sales_invoices (id)
        ) STRICT

name: sales_invoice_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_invoice_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_invoices (id),
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unit IN ('base', 'pack')),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
          discount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (discount >= 0),
          net INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (net >= 0),
          vat_rate INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (vat >= 0),
          cost INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: sales_invoices
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_invoices (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id),
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          reference TEXT NOT NULL,
          notes TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          eta_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          eta_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        ) STRICT

name: sales_receipt_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_receipt_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          receipt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_receipts (id),
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (unit IN ('base', 'pack')),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          unit_price INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price >= 0),
          gross INTEGER NOT NULL,
          net INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat_rate INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL,
          cost INTEGER NOT NULL
        , discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount >= 0)) STRICT

name: sales_receipt_payments
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_receipt_payments (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          receipt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_receipts (id),
          method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cash', 'card', 'wallet')),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0)
        ) STRICT

name: sales_receipts
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_receipts (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          at TEXT NOT NULL,
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          cash_received INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cash_received >= 0),
          eta_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          eta_previous_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          eta_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        , shift_id INTEGER REFERENCES shifts (id), customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers (id), eta_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '') STRICT

name: sales_return_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_return_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          return_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_returns (id),
          receipt_line_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_receipt_lines (id),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
          net INTEGER NOT NULL,
          vat INTEGER NOT NULL,
          cost INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: sales_returns
sql:
CREATE TABLE sales_returns (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          number INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          at TEXT NOT NULL,
          receipt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_receipts (id),
          shift_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          refund TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (refund IN ('cash', 'account')),
          eta_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          eta_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        , eta_previous_uuid TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', eta_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '') STRICT

name: serial_movements
sql:
CREATE TABLE serial_movements (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          serial_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES serials (id),
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity IN (-1, 1)),
          source TEXT NOT NULL,
          source_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
          line_id INTEGER
        ) STRICT

name: serials
sql:
CREATE TABLE serials (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          serial TEXT NOT NULL,
          UNIQUE (item_id, serial)
        ) STRICT

name: setup
sql:
CREATE TABLE setup (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
          finished_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('opening', 'new', 'existing'))
        ) STRICT

name: shifts
sql:
CREATE TABLE shifts (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),
          opened_at TEXT NOT NULL,
          opening_float INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (opening_float >= 0),
          closed_at TEXT,
          counted_cash INTEGER,
          close_entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          CHECK ((closed_at IS NULL) = (counted_cash IS NULL))
        ) STRICT

name: stock_count_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE stock_count_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          count_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES stock_counts (id),
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          expected INTEGER NOT NULL,
          counted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (counted >= 0),
          value INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: stock_counts
sql:
CREATE TABLE stock_counts (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          memo TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id)
        ) STRICT

name: stock_movements
sql:
CREATE TABLE "stock_movements" (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
          value INTEGER NOT NULL,
          source TEXT NOT NULL,
          source_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
          CHECK (quantity <> 0 OR value <> 0)
        ) STRICT

name: stock_transfers
sql:
CREATE TABLE stock_transfers (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          from_warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          to_warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          memo TEXT NOT NULL,
          CHECK (from_warehouse_id <> to_warehouse_id)
        ) STRICT

name: suppliers
sql:
CREATE TABLE suppliers (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          tax_registration_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
          active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
        , currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EGP' CHECK (currency IN ('EGP', 'USD', 'EUR', 'CNY')), withholding_category_id INTEGER REFERENCES withholding_categories (id)) STRICT

name: tax_codes
sql:
CREATE TABLE tax_codes (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          kind TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (kind IN ('standard', 'zero_rated', 'exempt')),
          name TEXT NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: tax_rates
sql:
CREATE TABLE tax_rates (
          tax_code_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tax_codes (id),
          effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
          rate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rate BETWEEN 0 AND 10000),
          PRIMARY KEY (tax_code_id, effective_from)
        ) STRICT

name: users
sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'storekeeper')),
          password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
          active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
        ) STRICT

name: warehouses
sql:
CREATE TABLE warehouses (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
          active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (active IN (0, 1))
        ) STRICT

name: withholding_categories
sql: CREATE TABLE withholding_categories (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE) STRICT

name: withholding_rates
sql:
CREATE TABLE withholding_rates (
          category_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES withholding_categories (id),
          effective_from TEXT NOT NULL,
          rate INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (rate BETWEEN 0 AND 10000),
          PRIMARY KEY (category_id, effective_from)
        ) STRICT

name: write_off_lines
sql:
CREATE TABLE write_off_lines (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          write_off_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES write_offs (id),
          item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id),
          quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
          value INTEGER NOT NULL
        ) STRICT

name: write_offs
sql:
CREATE TABLE write_offs (
          id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
          date TEXT NOT NULL,
          warehouse_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouses (id),
          reason TEXT NOT NULL,
          entry_id INTEGER REFERENCES journal_entries (id),
          user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id)
        ) STRICT

name: audit_log_no_removal
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_removal BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit log is append-only'); END

name: audit_log_no_update
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log
          BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'audit log is append-only'); END
